featured_reviews.review_text:
I visited this place after seeing a reel on Instagram. We ordered Pomfret and Surmai. Unfortunately, the ambience was very dull and not impressive.
They served us a thali which included prawn gravy. The prawns in the gravy were not cooked properly. When we complained to the captain, he said that they usually boil the prawns and keep them ready. He replaced the gravy and served us a new one, but even that had undercooked prawns.
Overall, it was a very disappointing experience. Definitely not recommended.

featured_reviews.name: Shabdali
featured_reviews.review_text:
I recently visited Village Koliwada and had an amazing experience! The food was delicious, with a perfect blend of flavors and spices. The service was top-notch, with friendly and attentive staff who made sure we had everything we needed.

The staff's hospitality was exceptional - they were warm, welcoming, and made us feel at home. The atmosphere was cozy and rustic, adding to the overall dining experience.

*Highlights:*

- Delicious food with authentic flavors
- Friendly and attentive staff
- Cozy and rustic ambiance
- *Seafood Lovers Rejoice!* Village Koliwada is a MUST-VISIT for all seafood enthusiasts! Fresh, flavorful, and finger-licking good - their seafood dishes are not to be missed!

*Rating Breakdown:*

- Food: 4.5/5
- Service: 5/5
- Ambiance: 4/5
- Overall Experience: 4.5/5

*HIGHLY RECOMMENDED!* If you're looking for a great dining experience with authentic food, friendly service, and amazing seafood, Village Koliwada is a must-visit!

featured_reviews.name: Shanawaz Durrani
featured_reviews.review_text:
Visited The Village Koliwada in Vasai West for dinner with a friend, and had a fantastic experience! The restaurant is known for its delicious fish dishes, and it truly lived up to the hype.

We ordered Pomfret Tandoori, Surmai Masala Gravy, Bhakari, Rice, and Rava Bombil Fry — and everything was absolutely tasty. The Pomfret Tandoori was the star of the evening — perfectly cooked and bursting with flavor.

The staff was polite and attentive, and the service was smooth throughout. The ambiance on the first floor was excellent, clean and comfortable, making it a great place to enjoy a relaxed meal.

Highly recommend this place to seafood lovers. Will definitely be visiting again!

featured_reviews.name: rukhsana merchant
featured_reviews.review_text:
I had a wonderful experience at The Village Koliwada. The food is absolutely delicious, with every dish full of authentic flavors. The thalis are a must-try, they’re wholesome, satisfying, and beautifully put together. The starters are equally impressive, truly scrumptious and full of taste.
The ambience is cozy and inviting, making it a perfect place to relax and enjoy a good meal. What really stood out was the staff, they are incredibly warm, friendly, and welcoming, which made the whole experience even better.
Overall, it’s a place we genuinely love visiting and would highly recommend to anyone looking for great food and a comfortable dining experience.

featured_reviews.name: Ashwini Turate
featured_reviews.review_text:
Yesterday we visited The Village Koliwada seafood restaurant in Vasai West after seeing a lot of hype and positive reviews. Because of that, our expectations were quite high.
We ordered a Surmai thali and a Prawns thali, but unfortunately the experience was disappointing. The fish did not feel fresh at all—both the surmai and prawns tasted like they were taken from the freezer. The overall taste of the food was average and did not match the expectations created by the reviews.
Seafood restaurants are mainly known for freshness, and that was missing here. Because of this experience, we do not feel like visiting again.
We hope the restaurant looks into this seriously and improves the quality and freshness, so customers will feel happy to return in the future.

featured_reviews.name: Ryan Mendonca
featured_reviews.review_text:
The food was undoubtedly excellent and one of the best aspects of the dining experience. Every dish was flavorful, well-prepared, and worth the wait—if only the service had matched the quality of the food.

Unfortunately, the service was one of the worst I have experienced. Every time we asked about the status of our order, we were repeatedly told that the food would be ready in "5 minutes." This response was given multiple times, which turned out to be completely misleading. After waiting for over 20 minutes with no food served, we finally asked for the bill and decided to leave. Ironically, only then did the staff suddenly seem ready to bring out the food.

The lack of transparency, poor communication, and disregard for customers' time was extremely frustrating. It felt as though we were being given false updates rather than honest information about the delay. If there were an option to rate the service below 1 star, I would gladly give it a 0.

It's disappointing because the food itself was great, but the overall experience was ruined by the unprofessional and disorganized service. Management should seriously address these issues, as good food alone cannot make up for such an unpleasant customer experience.
featured_reviews.response_from_owner_text:
Dear Ryan,

I sincerely apologise for the inconvenience caused. I will personally look into the matter and ensure it is resolved promptly.

Thank you for your feedback. We have been struggling with our cooking staff for a while now, though this is by no means an excuse for the service you received.

Once again, I’m truly sorry for the experience. We hope to welcome you back soon and make it right.

Best regards,
Kokum

featured_reviews.name: Pankaj
featured_reviews.review_text:
Visited Fishermen's Deck in Vasai and had an absolutely fantastic seafood feast! The crab masala was the star of the meal—fresh, meaty, and cooked perfectly in a rich, flavorful coastal-style gravy. Every bite tasted authentic and packed with spices.
The fish fry was equally impressive—crispy on the outside, juicy and fresh inside. You can genuinely tell that they use fresh seafood, which makes all the difference. The rice, bhakri, and accompaniments complemented the dishes perfectly.
If you're a seafood lover, this place is definitely worth visiting. Great taste, generous portions, and fresh catch cooked the right way. Highly recommended for anyone craving authentic seafood in Vasai! 🦀🐟🌊

featured_reviews.name: swapnil bhise
featured_reviews.review_text:
⭐⭐⭐⭐⭐ A Must-Visit for Seafood Lovers!
Loved the Surmai Thali and Prawns Thali at Fishermen’s Deck. The surmai fry was perfectly crisp and flavourful, while the prawns thali was rich, fresh, and authentically coastal. Generous portions, great taste, and quick service and solkadi was delicious and refreshing.Definitely worth a visit! 🌊🐟🍤

featured_reviews.name: sneha jadhav
featured_reviews.review_text:
While on a long drive in Vasai, we stumbled upon this cute little restaurant all decked up for ChristmasFisherman’s Deck and immediately hopped in. Seafood lovers, this is a must-try spot!

We tried:

Kokum Drink – not entirely authentic but tasty, like the bottled version

Surmai Thali – WOW! The fish was huge and cooked to perfection

Prawns Fry – crispy coating, very flavorful

A little note: I felt the dishes were slightly low on spice and salt, but that’s just my taste.

Overall, the freshness of the seafood and the way everything was prepared was amazing. Our bill was around ₹800, which was totally reasonable for the quantity and quality. Definitely a must-visit for fish lovers!
featured_reviews.response_from_owner_text:
Dear Sneha,

thank you for your lovely feedback. 

We have also started a New dish today onwards - Seafood Boil.

Welcome back to enjoy these new flavours !!!

featured_reviews.name: Joseph Nunes
featured_reviews.review_text:
I had high expectations from Fishermen's Deck given its seafood focus, but the experience was far from pleasant. The restaurant barely lives up to its name. Here’s why:

Food Quality: The seafood tasted stale and lacked freshness. For a place that claims to specialize in coastal cuisine, this was a huge letdown.

Service: Extremely slow and inattentive staff. Even basic requests took ages to fulfill.  They are not even positive of the water they provide and asked us to buy the bottled water - no regular water is served here.

Ambience: The interiors felt cramped and poorly maintained. Definitely not the cozy, elegant vibe they advertise.

Value for Money: At an average cost of ₹1400 for two, the quality and quantity were nowhere near worth the price.  Even the slices of Surmai fish were like sliced so thin, that you couldn't even get a mouthful.

Overall Rating: With an average rating of just 2.6/5 on review platforms, my experience sadly confirms why it’s rated so low

featured_reviews.name: Anuradha Sen
featured_reviews.review_text: The food is good and the ambience is cozy. We tried fish fingers and clams masala and it was really tasty and fresh. Crab thali and Maharaja thali was also good. They have a unique menu which includes all the dishes that the owner likes hence there is no veg food on the menu is what we were told. This place is definitely worth a try for good seafood.

featured_reviews.name: Bhakti Jadhav
featured_reviews.review_text: Absolutely delicious! The Sea food here is authentic and flavorfull, just right, and incredibly fresh. We are visit first time in this restaurant n ordered prawns rawa fry and pomfret thali both were outstanding. Service was prompt and friendly. A new favorite spot!".

featured_reviews.name: Deekshita Gujaran
featured_reviews.review_text:
The fish was absolutely outstanding !! super fresh, perfectly cooked, and the authentic masala is truly next level. You can taste that homely coastal flavour in every bite.

Special mention to their green chutney, one of the best I’ve had! It just elevates the whole meal.

Highly recommend this place to all seafood lovers. If you’re around Virar–Vasai and craving authentic seafood, this is a must-visit.

Guys are extremely sweet and very interactive, which makes the whole experience even better.

featured_reviews.name: Mahi Makwana
featured_reviews.review_text:
This place is truly special for me and my family. We recently visited again, and it continues to be one of our absolute favorite spots for seafood in vasai ..
The fish thali and starters are incredibly authentic, fresh, and full of flavor – you can really feel the love and effort in every dish. The taste is perfectly balanced, just like home-cooked coastal food.
What makes this place even more amazing is the warmth of the owners. They treat us like family, which makes every visit even more memorable and comfortable.
It’s not just about food here, it’s about the experience, the connection, and the feeling of being welcomed.
Highly recommended for anyone who loves authentic fish thali and a homely vibe. We will keep coming back again and again ❤️
featured_reviews.response_from_owner_text:
Dear Mahi / Jyoti,

You, Devansh and your fam are always special to us and we love serving you and chitchating with the little kiddo. We thank you for your presence travelling from so far to enjoy our dishes served witb love and flavours. 
We look forward to your visits and our chats !!

See you soon !!


Halley ( Fishermen's Deck)
